title: GTA 6 hype and impact will eventually be matched by another game, ex-PlayStation boss says, but it might be up to Rockstar to make it: "After 15 years, maybe GTA 7"

Games Action Games Grand Theft Auto GTA 6 GTA 6 hype and impact will eventually be matched by another game, ex-PlayStation boss says, but it might be up to Rockstar to make it: "After 15 years, maybe GTA 7" News By Catherine Lewis Published 1 October 2026 Shuhei Yoshida says other companies might try to compete in the gap after GTA 6, too When you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here's how it works . (Image credit: Rockstar Games) Copy link Facebook X Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter We could be waiting quite some time to see another game as impactful as GTA 6, former PlayStation boss Shuhei Yoshida suggests, and it may even be on Rockstar itself to do it with GTA 7. GTA 6 is quite easily one of, if not the single most hyped up game of all time, with immeasurable excitement from fans who've been waiting over 13 years since the last installment, and most devs and publishers fleeing as far from Rockstar Games ' November launch as they can to avoid their games getting swallowed up and forgotten. Its impending release has seemingly influenced consoles going out of stock and being sold for ridiculous prices , and people are so excited that some have even been willing to spend $400 on a box of merch including, uh, a spoon. With all that, on top of years of fan discussion, wild theories, and speculation... it's kind of a lot. Speaking in a new episode of The Verge's Vergecast (below), the former president of Sony Interactive Entertainment worldwide studios is asked if we're ever going to see another game like GTA 6 in the future. Latest Videos From GamesRadar+ Watch full video here: "After 15 years, maybe GTA 7, we'll see," he laughs. That's not to say that he thinks Rockstar is the only studio capable, though. Shuhei Yoshida on the future of gaming | The Vergecast - YouTube Watch On "Or any of these companies from China, they might try to emulate or compete, because there will be [a] 15 year gap after GTA 6," he continues. "So no one should underestimate the power of these Chinese companies." You may like Former PlayStation boss says devs need to reach people who don't care about GTA 6 GTA 5 dev "can only imagine the size of GTA 6" - "It must be monstrous" GTA 6 is "going to raise the bar," Helldivers 2 boss says, and he's "happy" it's not launching on PC Honestly, the mere concept of GTA 7 and the inevitable build-up to that makes me feel dizzy when we've not yet reached GTA 6's launch - this year's launch feels mythical enough as it is. But who knows what a post GTA 6 world is going to look like? Out of its shadow, could we see similar levels of hype and impact for a Switch 2 version of Nintendogs? Perhaps not, but it'd be interesting to take the spotlight away from Rockstar for a while, at least. GTA 6's weather is completely re-engineered from Red Dead Redemption 2, and it has hurricanes, rainbows, proper cloud formations and more.
